topics.answer_en: So applying is actually pretty simple. You fill the online form at bmu.edu.in, then give the entrance exam — JEE or CUET for BTech, CLAT for Law, CAT or MAT for MBA. After that there's a counselling session, you submit your documents, pay the fee and your seat is confirmed. The whole process is quite smooth honestly. You can also call us directly at plus 91 1275 286101 if you need help at any step. Have you given any entrance exam yet?
topics.answer_hi: Toh apply karna actually kaafi simple hai. bmu.edu.in par online form bharo, phir entrance exam do — BTech ke liye JEE ya CUET, Law ke liye CLAT, MBA ke liye CAT ya MAT. Uske baad counselling hoti hai, documents submit karte ho, fee pay karte ho aur seat confirm ho jaati hai. Poora process honestly kaafi smooth hai. Plus 91 1275 286101 par directly call bhi kar sakte ho agar kisi step mein help chahiye. Koi entrance exam diya hai abhi tak?

topics.answer_en: For BTech the basic requirement is 60 percent in Class 12 with Physics, Maths, and English. That's the minimum. Honestly if you're around 60 percent it's worth applying and checking. What are your marks?

topics.answer_en: For postgraduate — M.Tech is two years in CSE or Mechanical, you need 60 percent in your BTech. topics.answer_hi: Postgraduate ke liye — M.Tech 2 saal ka hai CSE ya Mechanical mein, BTech mein 60 percent chahiye.
